description: This file defines a set of React components for a custom select dropdown UI, wrapping Radix UI primitives with additional styling and behavior.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main wrapper component for the select dropdown, rendering Radix UI's Root component.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping select items, wrapping Radix UI's Group component.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Component displaying the selected value, wrapping Radix UI's Value component.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button that opens the dropdown, wrapping Radix UI's Trigger with custom styling.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content, wrapping Radix UI's Content with custom animations and positioning.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Component for labeling sections within the select dropdown, wrapping Radix UI's Label.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component for individual selectable items, wrapping Radix UI's Item.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for separating groups of items, wrapping Radix UI's Separator.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Component for scrolling up in the dropdown list, wrapping Radix UI's ScrollUpButton.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Component for scrolling down in the dropdown list, wrapping Radix UI's ScrollDownButton.
